$comment: MCP Server Card, SEP-1649 shape (schema still standardising in modelcontextprotocol PR #2127). There is no server to install: the tools are served through Apify's hosted MCP server and the caller signs in with their own Apify account, so runs are billed to them at each actor's pay-per-event price.

serverInfo.name: Perch Data
serverInfo.description: Prediction-market, sports and public-records data joined to the official source that settles it. Kalshi and Polymarket daily temperature ladders joined to the weather station named in each market's own rules; ATP and WTA matches with odds, form and head-to-head; Nashville building permits with contractor and inspection data; kitchen floor-plan takeoffs; Apify Store demand by niche.

authentication.note: OAuth on first connect, or send Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>. Tokens come from https://console.apify.com/account/integrations and are the caller's own.
